description: Every metric on redlamp.app/performance. measuredBy: the harness that records it (bench: redlamp bench; sweep: scripts/perf-sweep.sh; folders: scripts/folders-perf.sh), or [] when only the README's history has it. readme: how scripts/perf-backfill.py finds it in past READMEs: a table row whose label starts with `row` (`phrase` picks one of several values in the cell by the label's own wording; `columns` reads a table whose columns are stages, the last being current), or a `pattern` in the text, with an optional `before` pattern for a figure quoted from before a change.
